claim_text: Our Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions decreased from FY24 to FY25, despite FY25 being the first full year of gold production.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: Direct FY24–FY25 quantitative evidence is not available because FY25 Scope 1, Scope 2, and emissions intensity values in the ESG Data Pack are marked “TBD in September”. Therefore, the claim cannot be clearly verified using the available data.
llm_reason: The decisive assertion is that Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions decreased from FY24 to FY25, with the contextual qualifier that FY25 was the first full year of gold production. No evidence fields were provided with any FY24 and FY25 Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions values, totals, or other factual disclosures to verify a decrease, nor any substantiation about FY25 being the first full year of gold production. As a result, the claim’s central emissions-reduction assertion is not meaningfully grounded in the provided evidence.
